notes: Fiscal 2024 ended February 2, 2025 (Home Depot's own label; matches data.js fy 'Feb 2025'). Filings: Fiscal 2024 Form 10-K (accession 0000354950-25-000085) and 2025 proxy statement (accession 0000354950-25-000123), both read on www.sec.gov. ARTHUR BLANK: co-founder, not a director or officer; he does not appear in the proxy's beneficial ownership tables (directors, NEOs and holders over 5%), so no stake is reported. HOLDERS: the proxy says the 5% table shows shares 'held as of December 31, 2024', but its footnotes cite Schedule 13G/A filings made in January and February 2024, which normally report holdings at the end of 2023. Because of this conflict, asOf is null. Percentages use the March 7, 2025 share count. BUYBACKS: $649 million paid before Home Depot paused repurchases in March 2024 ahead of the SRS acquisition. STOCK COMP: the note total ($444 million, including ESPP expense); the cash-flow add-back is $442 million.
